title: Ngā Ringa Kanga
intro: Kei te tū koe i ngā ara piko o Makkah onamata, te wāhi i tahuri ke ai te wairua whai mana me te whai rawa i te karanga o te pono. He whakamahara nui te kōrero a tēnei tangata kāore e taea e ngā hononga toto te wikitoria i ngā mekameka o te whakapehapeha. Ko wai tēnei tangata e haruru ana tōna ingoa i roto i te ahi e tatari ana?
clues: I hikoi ahau i ngā tiriti o Makkah me te whakapehapeha i whakamatapo i ahau ki te pono, ahakoa nōku ake te karere.
He nui rawa aku taonga, engari i riro hei kanga, ehara i te whakangungu rakau.
E kōrero ana te pukapuka arataki mō tōku whakangaromanga, e kī ana ka ngaro ōku ringa me tōku tinana.
I uru atu taku hoa rangatira ki taku pakanga mauahara, i kohikohi tataramoa hei hora i te ara o te tangata i karanga ki a Allah.
I te rā o te whakawa, ka rukuhia ahau ki te ahi mura, ā, ka herea taku hoa rangatira ki te taura muka nikau hei whitiki mō tōna kaki.
E mōhiotia ana ahau i tētahi ingoa ko tōna tikanga ko 'matua o te mura' — he ingoa e tohu ana i tōku kāinga mutunga kore.
